name: frontend-ui-ux-pro
description: Frontend UI/UX Pro bundles the full UI/UX Pro Max local design database for product design systems, UX audits, accessibility checks, visual polish, and stack-specific frontend guidance without requiring user-installed Python.

interface.shortDescription: Full UI/UX Pro Max design intelligence with local database.
interface.longDescription: Frontend UI/UX Pro bundles UI/UX Pro Max as a dedicated personal plugin. It uses local CSV design data and a PowerShell wrapper that prefers Codex bundled Python, with a no-Python CSV fallback for design systems, UI audits, accessibility, typography, color, charts, and frontend stack guidance.
defaultPrompt: Create a UI/UX design system for this product.
Audit this interface for UX, accessibility, and polish.
Improve this screen using UI/UX Pro Max guidance.
